005-a.text: a decline from $100k to $78k is a real $22k loss in current value whether or not the position is sold (mark-to-market)
005-a.source_title: Why "You Don't Lose Money Until You Sell" Is Bunk

005-b.text: selling forgoes future appreciation/income while also avoiding further potential loss (opportunity cost is symmetric)
005-b.source_title: Why "You Don't Lose Money Until You Sell" Is Bunk

005-c.text: selling changes tax status (realizes a gain/loss) but that is separate from whether value was actually lost
005-c.source_title: Why "You Don't Lose Money Until You Sell" Is Bunk

005-d.text: the phrase encourages anchoring to purchase price rather than market price (anchoring bias)
005-d.source_title: Why "You Don't Lose Money Until You Sell" Is Bunk

005-e.text: believing losses aren't real until sale makes investors hold underperformers longer, risking deeper losses
005-e.source_title: Why "You Don't Lose Money Until You Sell" Is Bunk

005-f.text: the mindset discourages tax-loss harvesting that could cut taxes while keeping market exposure
005-f.source_title: Why "You Don't Lose Money Until You Sell" Is Bunk
